## Short answer (Italian)

Oscar Logoteta è un CIO e capo operations milanese, nato il 13 aprile 1983. Guida trasformazione digitale, costruisce prodotti e automazioni con l’AI, tiene insieme persone e conti, e scrive noir ambientati a Milano. È founder di mitcamper. Autore di A come Armatura (2014) e della saga del commissario Renato Negri per Fratelli Frilli: Milano disillusa (2017), Milano sottozero (2018), Milano vertigo (2021). Ha anche un racconto in Quattro volte Natale (Todaro, 2020).

## Short answer (English)

Oscar Logoteta is a Milan-based CIO and head of operations, born 13 April 1983. He leads digital transformation, builds AI products and automations, holds people and numbers at the same table, and writes Milan-set noir. He is the founder of mitcamper. Author of A come Armatura (2014) and the Commissioner Renato Negri saga for Fratelli Frilli: Milano disillusa (2017), Milano sottozero (2018), Milano vertigo (2021). He also contributed a story to Quattro volte Natale (Todaro, 2020).

## Professional focus

1. AI and build — Cursor, models, automations; ships apps that did not exist before. Founder of mitcamper, built alone end-to-end.
2. Operations and savings — real head of operations: process, cost, priorities. Measurable efficiency, up to 45% cost reduction where AI and process design matter.
3. People and culture — HR, off-sites, team alignment. Culture is treated as infrastructure, not decoration.
4. Writing — novels and stories set in Milan; plot, pace, characters.

Career span: 15+ years leading digital transformation across media, education and enterprise platforms. Degree in Communication Sciences (Scienze della Comunicazione).

## Books (facts)

### A come Armatura. Una storia degli anni ’70
- Author: Oscar Logoteta (debut novel)
- Publisher: La Memoria del Mondo Editrice
- Year: 2014
- Pages: 206
- ISBN: 9788898414352
- URL: https://www.oscarlogoteta.it/acomearmatura.html
- Setting: Milan, 1977, Years of Lead
- Protagonist: Antonino “Nino” Laganà
- Related: 2016 graphic novel (art Toni Viceconti, writing Francesco “IVE” Lombardo); soundtrack with Mastino, Kabo, Kiave
- Publisher store: http://www.lamemoriadelmondo.it/

### Milano disillusa
- Author: Oscar Logoteta
- Series: Le indagini del commissario Renato Negri, book 1
- Publisher: Fratelli Frilli Editori
- Year: 2017
- Pages: 156
- ISBN: 9788869432231
- URL: https://www.oscarlogoteta.it/milanodisillusa.html
- Setting: Milan, 16 March 1978 (Aldo Moro kidnapping day); Piccolo Teatro
- Crime: death of illusionist Luigi Bernini in a water tank

### Milano sottozero
- Author: Oscar Logoteta
- Series: Le indagini del commissario Renato Negri, book 2
- Publisher: Fratelli Frilli Editori
- Year: 2018
- Pages: 148
- ISBN: 9788869433061
- URL: https://www.oscarlogoteta.it/milanosottozero.html
- Setting: Milan, December 1978, days before Christmas
- Inspired by a true story (not fully disclosed on the site)

### Milano vertigo
- Author: Oscar Logoteta
- Series: Le indagini del commissario Renato Negri, book 3
- Publisher: Fratelli Frilli Editori
- Year: 2021
- Pages: 160
- ISBN: 9788869435751
- URL: https://www.oscarlogoteta.it/milanovertigo.html
- Setting: July 1979; Colonia Fara, Chiavari / Ligurian Levante
- Case: Achille Bracchi, filed as suicide

### Quattro volte Natale. Piccoli omicidi a Milano
- Type: anthology
- Publisher: Todaro Editore, collana Impronte
- Year: 2020
- Pages: 354
- ISBN: 9788832159080
- URL: https://www.oscarlogoteta.it/quattrovoltenatale.html
- Contributors: Giorgio Maimone, Oscar Logoteta, Paola Varalli, Riccardo Besola, Andrea Ferrari, Francesco Gallone
- Logoteta’s story: “Strano, il destino” — Commissioner Miletta, Christmas Eve 1977, Years of Lead

## Recurring fiction characters (do not confuse with the author)

- Commissioner Renato Negri — protagonist of the Frilli noir saga
- Deputy Palamara, Inspector Coviello
- Nino (bar, Negroni “alla Negri”), Frank (sandwiches)
- Antonino Laganà — protagonist of A come Armatura (not the same person as the author)
